description: This file contains unit tests for Azure Queue stream filtering functionality in an Orleans-based distributed system. It defines test classes, fixtures, and configuration for testing stream filtering with Azure Queue providers.

classes.name: AQStreamFilteringTests
classes.description: Test class for Azure Queue stream filtering, implementing setup and teardown for tests, and defining specific test cases.

classes.name: AQStreamFilteringTests.Fixture
classes.description: Fixture class for setting up the Azure test cluster environment with necessary configurations.

classes.name: AQStreamFilteringTests.Fixture.SiloConfigurator
classes.description: Configures the silo builder with Azure Queue streams, memory storage, and stream filters.

classes.name: AQStreamFilteringTests.Fixture.ClientConfigurator
classes.description: Configures the client builder with Azure Queue streams and stream filters.

methods.name: ConfigureTestCluster
methods.description: Configures the test cluster with Azure storage and stream configurations.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Configures the silo builder with Azure Queue streams, memory storage, and stream filters.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Configures the client builder with Azure Queue streams and stream filters.

methods.name: CheckPreconditionsOrThrow
methods.description: Checks if necessary preconditions like Azure Storage and Event Hub are available before running tests.

methods.name: IgnoreBadFilter
methods.description: Test method to verify ignoring bad filters.

methods.description: Test method to verify filtering only even items.

methods.name: MultipleSubscriptionsDifferentFilterData
methods.description: Test method to verify multiple subscriptions with different filter data.
